datasets.title: South Sudan - Village Assessment - Education Facilities
datasets.description: This survey was conducted by IOM DTM covering 182 out of 219 bomas (achieving 83 per cent coverage) in Wau, Rubkona, Bor South, Torit, Magwi, Aweil Centre and Malakal counties. IOM are currently carrying out mapping in Abyei AA, Central Equatoria - Kajo Keji, Yei, Morobo and Lainya and will update that dataset in late 2023. The dataset has education facilities' names, locations and the services available there.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/south-sudan-village-assessment-education-facilities-iom-dtm]

entity.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)

lineage.description: IOM DTM conducted a village assessment survey across 182 bomas in seven South Sudan counties (August 2019 to March 2020), documenting education facility locations and services using DTM standard methodology. The dataset represents a spatial inventory of education infrastructure with 83% coverage in surveyed areas.
